description: Implement RansomwareDetector class with behavioral monitoring of the data/ directory, bulk encryption pattern detection, alerting, and quarantine capabilities. Add an HTML monitoring page showing status and alerts.
steps: Step 1 - Create app/models/security.py with SQLAlchemy models: SecurityAlert (id, alert_type, severity, message, details_json, source_path, detected_at, acknowledged, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_at), MonitoringConfig (id, config_key, config_value, updated_at).

Step 2 - Create app/services/ransomware_detector.py with the RansomwareDetector class. Features: (a) monitors file operations on configurable data directory using watchdog (filesystem events library), (b) tracks operation rates (ops/sec) with sliding window, (c) detects bulk encryption patterns (many file writes in short time, entropy analysis of written content), (d) configurable thresholds (default: 50 ops/sec triggers alert), (e) can pause/quarantine suspicious operations by moving files to quarantine dir, (f) integrates with SecurityAlert model to persist alerts, (g) start/stop methods for lifecycle management. Handle watchdog import gracefully (add as optional dep).

Step 3 - Create app/api/security.py router with: GET /settings/security (HTML monitoring page), GET /api/security/status (monitoring status JSON), GET /api/security/alerts (list alerts), POST /api/security/alerts/{id}/acknowledge (acknowledge alert), POST /api/security/monitor/start (start monitoring), POST /api/security/monitor/stop (stop monitoring), GET /api/security/config (get thresholds), POST /api/security/config (update thresholds). Protect with require_permission('security', 'manage').

Step 4 - Create app/templates/settings_security.html template showing: monitoring status (active/inactive, uptime), real-time metrics (ops/sec, files monitored), alert history table (severity, message, timestamp, acknowledged status), configuration panel (thresholds, monitored directories), start/stop buttons. Use htmx for polling status updates.
Step 5 - Register the new router in app/api/router.py. Add SecurityAlert model to models/__init__.py.
Step 7 - Add navigation link to base.html for Settings > Security.
Step 8 - Add tests in tests/test_security.py covering: detector initialization, threshold detection logic (mock filesystem events), alert creation, API endpoint responses, start/stop lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: RansomwareDetector class exists with start/stop lifecycle
Detector monitors filesystem events and tracks ops/sec
Bulk encryption patterns are detected when threshold is exceeded
Alerts are persisted to SecurityAlert model
API endpoints for status, alerts, config work correctly
Alerts can be acknowledged via API
Monitoring can be started/stopped via API
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
